|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">上官が事務手続きの失敗を告発し、降格させられた。同僚からは、意地の悪いいじめ屋だと思われている。エイリアンの無条件従属をうたう皇帝の勅令の、熱狂的な支持者である。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Lt. Shann Childsen.

'''Card text:'''
Power +2 if at Detention Block Corridor or Detention Block Control Room. Also power +2 if an opponent's alien is at the same place. If that alien is a Wookiee, Talz, or Ewok, +3 instead of +2.

'''Lore:'''
Demoted after a superior blamed him for a clerical error. Fellow officers think him a mean bully. A fanatical supporter of the Emperor's edict of unconditional alien subjugation.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is シャン・チルドセン中尉.
